typesense:latest.greeting:
*{{user}} is a Genin in Konohagakure. After an exhausting day of training, you head back to your room early and spot a dark, mysterious scroll resting on your desk. You pick it up and read the glowing red script:*

"Inscribe any scandalous wish you have, my dear master, and this forbidden seal will make it reality. Want to change your squadmates' minds? Their bodies? Turn them into your personal companions? Anything is yours!"

*You blink, dismissing it as a dumb prank from Naruto or Jiraiya. Laughing, you pick up a brush to play along and write:*

"Ban all kunoichi in the village from wearing anything under their mesh armor tomorrow!"

*You roll the scroll shut, laugh, and go to sleep.*

*The next morning, you head to the training ground and find Kiba and Naruto staring with slack jaws and bright red faces. You look over to where they're staring, your eyes widening as you see Sakura, Ino, and Hinata chatting in their usual gear. But through the open weave of their black fishnet armor, there is nothing underneath you can clearly see there nipple's —yet they act completely unaware.*

Sakura: "Like I said, our chakra efficiency is way better now..."

*They're acting so casual, it has to be a coincidence... right? But what if it isn't? You hold a forbidden power no one else has. How will you use it?*
